about: Guesses an open-pass reviewer wrote and tested. A guess that held on several repos is a candidate kind.

guesses.guess: Translation keys used in components exist in en.json, and placeholders agree between en.json, the components and every translation.
guesses.perspective: new: src/lang was the least-opened folder (3% of lines).
guesses.test: Python scripts: (1) static keys from $t(), t() and keypath= in src/**/*.{vue,js,ts} against en.json; (2) the {name} token set per key in src/lang/*.json against en.json; (3) named template slots, or the top-level child count, of each <i18n-t> against en.json; (4) array and object arguments of $t(key, ...) against en.json. Results: 50 of 1,082 keys missing; 111 placeholder mismatches in 46 files; 4 real slot mismatches after manual review (Apprise, CallMeBot, SMSEagle and Ntfy flags were parser false positives).

guesses.guess: Every HTTP path the frontend calls has an Express route.
guesses.perspective: new: earlier passes checked socket events only.
guesses.held: no: every axios or baseURL path in src (Entry.vue, StatusPage.vue, SetupDatabase.vue, BadgeGeneratorDialog.vue, EditMonitor.vue, Details.vue) matches a route in server/routers/*.js, server/server.js or server/setup-database.js. This led to the badge parameter check.
guesses.test: grep for router.get, router.all and app.get or app.post in server/, against grep for axios and baseURL in src/.

guesses.guess: Browser storage keys are written and read under the same names and units.
guesses.held: yes, agreeing. locale (src/mixins/lang.js:35 to src/i18n.js:71) and timezone (src/components/settings/General.vue:261 to src/mixins/datetime.js:10) also agree but are single-value pairs, not recorded.
guesses.test: Python script listing every localStorage and sessionStorage key with its read and write sites, plus grep for storage().

guesses.guess: Every option value in the monitor form selects is a value the server handles.
guesses.perspective: deeper look at the vocabulary family: earlier seams cover type, smtpSecurity, operators and the proxy and docker dialogs, not these selects.
guesses.test: Python script listing each <select> v-model and its option values in src/pages/EditMonitor.vue, plus the option arrays at :1711-1738; grep for each field's comparisons in server/.

guesses.guess: Monitor deletion relies on foreign-key cascades that one backend lacks, or references that delete code does not clear.
guesses.perspective: new: the base schema seam covers columns and types, not delete paths.
guesses.held: no. SQLite enforces foreign keys (server/database.js:355). Child tables of monitor cascade (db/knex_init_db.js and the stat migrations). Proxy.delete, DockerHost.delete and RemoteBrowser.delete clear monitor references first (server/proxy.js:81, server/docker.js:60, server/remote-browser.js:65).
guesses.test: Python script listing references() and onDelete() per createTable in db/knex_init_db.js; grep for DELETE FROM and static async delete in server/.

guesses.guess: Values written to width-limited VARCHAR columns can exceed the width on MariaDB, which tests never run.
guesses.perspective: new: the brief says to check the backend branch the tests skip.
guesses.test: Python script listing every table.string and table.enum width in db/knex_init_db.js and db/knex_migrations/*.js; each writer read by hand; grep for maxlength in src/.

guesses.guess: Columns added in the 17 unopened knex migrations disagree with the code that reads them.
guesses.perspective: deeper look at monitor-editable-fields and base-schema-sqlite-vs-mariadb: the earlier pass opened 13 of 30 migrations.
guesses.held: yes for the stat tables. ip_family VARCHAR(4) and the snmp_version enum agree with the form. The monitor columns from every migration all appear in Monitor.toJSON, the editMonitor copy list and EditMonitor.vue, except the recorded manual_status.
guesses.test: Python script listing tables and columns per migration (up part only), then checking each monitor column for camelCase or snake_case presence in server/model/monitor.js:83-213, the editMonitor block of server/server.js and src/pages/EditMonitor.vue; every unopened migration read.

guesses.guess: Every 'npm run X' in CI, Dockerfiles, docs and scripts names an existing script.
guesses.test: Python script resolving every 'npm run X' in git ls-files output against the package.json of its own folder or the root.

guesses.guess: Language codes in rtlLangs, localization.scss or locale loaders disagree with languageList.
guesses.held: no. rtlLangs (src/i18n.js:63) and html[lang='fa'] (src/assets/localization.scss:1) name codes that are in languageList, and no dayjs or cronstrue locale is loaded by code.
guesses.test: grep for :lang, [lang, dayjs/locale and cronstrue/locales in src/.

guesses.guess: Badge query parameters offered by the generator differ from those the routes read.
guesses.perspective: deeper look at badge-duration-parameter, which checked only the duration path parameter.
guesses.test: Python script reading each badge route's const { ... } = request.query block in server/routers/api-router.js, against the parameters map in src/components/BadgeGeneratorDialog.vue:174-232 and its inputs.

guesses.guess: Notification providers follow the family rules: a name, async send, a success string, rethrow on failure, and the proxy helper.
guesses.perspective: new convention check over 83 providers, of which earlier passes opened half.
guesses.held: the rethrow rule holds; the only catch blocks without a throw are deliberate inner fallbacks (discord.js:27, nostr.js:60 and :73, slack.js:65). The proxy rule is broken by 5 providers.
guesses.test: Python scripts: per provider, count axios calls against getAxiosConfigWithProxy calls, and list each catch block whose body has no throw or throwGeneralAxiosError.

guesses.guess: Settings keys the server reads have writers under the same names.
guesses.perspective: deeper look at general-settings-defaults, which named some keys.
guesses.held: no new drift. All 13 keys the settings components bind are read on the server. Keys read but never written (title, description, icon, statusPageTheme, statusPagePublished, statusPageTags at server/database.js:546-566) are legacy keys that the status page migration reads.
guesses.test: Python script collecting setting() and Settings.get() keys in server/ and extra/ against setSetting() and Settings.set() keys and settings.X bindings in src/.

guesses.guess: Monitor type classes follow one shape: extend MonitorType, a name equal to the registry key, a check() method.
guesses.held: only a harmless difference: manual.js names itself 'Manual' while its registry key is 'manual' (server/uptime-kuma-server.js:122), but dispatch (server/model/monitor.js:849-851) and sendMonitorTypeList (server/client.js:220-239) use the key only. This check led to the next guess.
guesses.test: Python script per server/monitor-types/*.js printing the class, base, name, check(), supportsConditions and conditionVariables.

guesses.guess: Monitor checks report faults the way beat() expects, so Retries applies.
guesses.perspective: new: found while testing the monitor type family.
guesses.test: grep for 'status = DOWN' and throw counts per server/monitor-types/*.js and in the beat() inline branches; read CONTRIBUTING.md:183-189 and server/model/monitor.js:860-911; git show 0eebe86f.

guesses.guess: Fields the frontend reads from socket acknowledgements are fields the server callback sends.
guesses.perspective: deeper look at socket-event-names, which checked names and argument order only.
guesses.held: no: the only flags (TagsManager.vue:429, EditMaintenance.vue:457) come from nested emits.
guesses.test: Python script pairing each emit("name", ..., (res) => {...}) with the res.X fields it reads, against the top-level keys of every callback({...}) in that server handler.

guesses.guess: The status page custom URL added in the unopened 2025-05-09 migration has one writer and reader that agree.
guesses.test: grep for custom_url and customUrl in server/ and src/; read saveStatusPage, Group.getMonitorList, Monitor.toPublicJSON, StatusPage.vue and MonitorSettingDialog.vue.

guesses.guess: The PR test tool and the push client build each repeat a tag, a variable or a platform list in several files.
guesses.perspective: new: extra/kuma-pr and extra/uptime-kuma-push are in this packet's areas.
guesses.test: Read extra/kuma-pr/*, extra/checkout-pr.mjs, extra/uptime-kuma-push/*, package.json:43 and :62, and docker/dockerfile:62-90.

guesses.guess: Uptime and ping numbers are rounded the same way wherever they are shown.
guesses.perspective: new: the brief names formatting and rounding.
guesses.held: uptime differs (recorded). Ping display differs only cosmetically and is not recorded: CountUp.vue:40-50 shows '<1' and two decimals, while the ping and average-response badges truncate with parseInt (server/routers/api-router.js:322, :390).
guesses.test: grep for '* 100', toFixed and toPrecision in src/ and server/.

guesses.guess: Icon paths in public/manifest.json, index.html and the layouts exist in public/.
guesses.test: Python script printing the manifest icon paths; grep for href, src and data="/icon in index.html and src/; ls public/.
